paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County travelers choosing when to head home after Thanksgiving have two sunny days ahead before the next chance of rain. The National Weather Service in Memphis expects highs in the mid-50s Friday and mid-60s Saturday. Its 3:05 p.m. Wednesday county forecast puts Sunday’s rain chance at 70%.

The change is expected after midnight Saturday night, when the chance of showers reaches 30%. Sunday morning has the better chance of showers and a chance of thunderstorms. By afternoon, forecasters expect partial sunshine, with showers still possible and a smaller chance of thunderstorms. Sunday should be breezy, with a high in the upper 60s.

For people traveling sooner, Thanksgiving itself will be colder. The county forecast calls for clouds, a high in the mid-40s and northwest winds of 15 to 20 mph with gusts up to 30 mph. There is a 20% chance of afternoon rain. Thursday night’s low is around 30, and gusts could still reach 30 mph that evening.

Rain is expected in Pontotoc County through Wednesday evening, then becomes less likely after midnight. The coldest part of the night is forecast to reach the lower 30s. Friday night also looks cold, with clear skies and a low around 30 before Saturday’s warmup.
